subject: Function-identifier
notes: kb/Work PB847: `FUNCTION fp` with no argument-list parentheses is COBOL2234, decided from the parse before any bind; the keyword-omitted bare `fp` is the reference to the pointer itself. (Residual, filed as a lead: the keyword-omitted EMPTY list `fp ()` is a parse error - subscriptPart requires a token - so a zero-argument pointer call must be written `FUNCTION fp ()`.)
